description: WhatsApp inbox assistant, phase 2 (specs/agente-fase2.md): bubbles per turn, categories with per-conversation caps, drafts, escalation in two kinds, the seller's agent settings, proactive tasks. Replaces v1, which nothing in production consumed.

responses.200: AgentTaskResult (also when the task was already resolved: the stored result)
responses.409: AgentRefusalError (AGENT_TASK_EXPIRED: a send already claimed the task, which decides it)

x-routes.note: The panel only: the agent key never writes the voice key.
Removes the key and the voice; answers configured false.
System scope of the webhook, once per received voice note (never per text). The answer carries the key: nothing of it is logged.

responses.200: AgentReplyResponse (same clientMessageId replayed, or status draft)
responses.409: AgentRefusalError (AGENT_HELD, AGENT_CONTACT_EXITED, AGENT_OPTED_OUT, AGENT_OPEN_PROBLEM) or ReplyRefusedError (chip_down, no_sender_capacity)
responses.429: AgentRefusalError (AGENT_GLOBAL_CAP, AGENT_CATEGORY_CAP) or RateLimitedBody (the contact bucket shared with the panel)

responses.409: AgentRefusalError (AGENT_HELD, AGENT_CONTACT_EXITED, AGENT_OPTED_OUT, AGENT_ALREADY_OFFERED, AGENT_UPSELL_NOT_OFFERED, AGENT_OPEN_PROBLEM)
AgentRefusalError (AGENT_TASK_EXPIRED, AGENT_DAILY_CAP, AGENT_HELD, AGENT_CONTACT_EXITED, AGENT_OPTED_OUT) or ReplyRefusedError

x-routes.note: Enviar in the panel: sends the draft as the assistant, approved by the seller; it counts and never sets the human hold. Body empty.
Descartar (also after Editar, which is a normal panel reply). Answers draft null.
Assumir in the panel. Body empty.
Soltar in the panel. Releases the hold and the open escalation; the window counters stay.

isoInstant.description: UTC instant with milliseconds and Z. Every agentHeldAt (explicit and human hold), every offer stamp and createdAt use this one format.

receivedInstant.description: RFC 3339 arrival stamp of a message (up to nanoseconds, +00:00), as the inbox stores it.

agentContactKey.description: A phone in E.164 digits. The assistant never reaches a lid: contact (the reply refuses it with contact_without_phone, the pending list skips it).

holdReason.description: seller (Assumir), agent (the assistant asked for a human) and cap (the 10th reply of the window) are EXPLICIT; human (a human reply from the panel or the phone) is IMPLICIT and expires 12 hours after the last human message.

holdFieldsCoherence.description: agentHeldAt, agentHeldReason and agentHeldNote move together: no hold, no reason and no note; a note only with reason agent.

tasks.description: Tasks due now, oldest first. The run for a task sends with POST agent/tasks/{taskId}/messages.

by.description: Who wrote an outgoing message: agent, seller (panel or phone) or auto (funnel, rule); null on incoming.

privateNote.description: The assistant's private note for the seller, on the FIRST message of its turn (shown in the inbox, never sent); null on every other message.

ConversationFlags.description: The header of a conversation: the fields of the detail, at the same level as the page of messages.

ConversationPage.description: GET .../messages, panel and assistant: a page of messages and the ConversationFlags at the same level. agentHeldAt is null for an expired implicit hold.

AgentReplyBody.description: One turn of the assistant. The saas decides mode (draft for a contact outside the auto-send list) and category/categoryProven (a link it minted); the core never takes either from the model. No keyId: authorship is by=agent on the stored messages.

duplicate.description: true when the same clientMessageId was already stored (a replay): status 200 instead of 201.

AgentReplyResponse.description: status sent: messages are the stored bubbles in order (each a delivery). status draft: nothing left, no counter moved. agentHeldAt is non-null ONLY when THIS turn created the cap hold (the last of the global cap).

AgentHoldResponse.description: The explicit hold the summary holds after the call (agent hold and the panel Assumir). created is true ONLY when THIS call created it; calling again on an explicitly held conversation rewrites nothing (stamp, reason and note stay the first) and answers created false. An explicit hold replaces an implicit one. agentHeldNote only with reason agent.

AgentReleaseResponse.description: The panel Soltar (DELETE agent-hold): the hold and the open escalation go; the counters of the window STAY. releasedAt is now; releasedCode the escalation code that was open or held (null when none), refused for 24 h after this (AGENT_ALREADY_ESCALATED).

AgentState.description: GET .../state: what the saas reads before every action and hands to the model. counters replace repliesToday. escalation is the open continue-kind one; agentHeldCode the code of a silence-kind hold. recentRealSend: the chip sent this contact a real GG delivery in the last 7 days; chipBusinessOnly: the conversation chip is marked store-only. Both feed the saas auto-send decision.

exited.description: The contact sent SAIR or PARAR.

optedOut.description: The seller marked the contact as opt-out.

AgentRefusalError.description: A refusal of the assistant. 409: AGENT_HELD, AGENT_CONTACT_EXITED, AGENT_OPTED_OUT, AGENT_ALREADY_OFFERED, AGENT_UPSELL_NOT_OFFERED, AGENT_ALREADY_ESCALATED (same code open, or released less than 24 h ago), AGENT_OPEN_PROBLEM (a sale turn while an escalation is open), AGENT_RETENTION_GATE (refund before the seller's retention attempts were SENT), AGENT_ASK_EMAIL_FIRST (purchase escalation with the phone search empty, no e-mail search and no reply since), AGENT_SETTINGS_CHANGED, AGENT_TASK_EXPIRED (the task is no longer pending: resolved or past its deadline), AGENT_DAILY_CAP (the contact already got the seller's daily number of recovery or sale messages: the task waits for the next BRT day inside its deadline), AGENT_VOICE_KEY_MISSING. 429: AGENT_GLOBAL_CAP, AGENT_CATEGORY_CAP (with category). 404: AGENT_CONVERSATION_NOT_FOUND, AGENT_DRAFT_NOT_FOUND, AGENT_TASK_NOT_FOUND, AGENT_VOICE_NOT_FOUND.

ReplyRefusedError.description: The reply cannot leave. 409 for chip_down and no_sender_capacity (the seller can choose another chip or wait), 422 for the rest.

InboxErrorBody.description: 400 INVALID_INBOX_PAYLOAD (also a pending limit outside 1 to 20, an empty or oversized reason, an unknown body field such as keyId), 403 INBOX_TERMS_REQUIRED or INBOX_SCOPE_REQUIRED, 404 CHIP_NOT_FOUND, 409 INBOX_TERMS_VERSION_CHANGED, 503 INBOX_UNAVAILABLE (with Retry-After; a reply that left but was not stored answers it too, and the same clientMessageId replays the write).

RateLimitedBody.description: 429 from a rate bucket (the Retry-After header carries the wait). The reply contact bucket is shared with the panel; an assistant refusal that is a pure read (held, SAIR, opt-out, cap) never charges it.

AgentKeyStatus.description: Inactive: only {active: false}. Active: the id, the preview and the creation stamp, never the key.

AgentKeyCreated.description: 201. The only time the plaintext key is ever answered.

AgentKeyExistsError.description: 409: the seller already has a live agent key (one per seller).

AgentKeyAuthenticated.description: 200: the owner of the key. keyId identifies the key (panel and audit); it is NOT an actor of the replies.

category.description: What a turn is about. sale, recovery and access are proven by the saas (a link it minted or the tool used); support, retention and free are declared by the model. support and access count only on the global cap; retention feeds the refund gate.

escalationCode.description: Continue kind (the assistant keeps answering): refund, double_charge, unsolved, off_topic, unreadable_media. Silence kind (an explicit hold): legal, human_requested.

Counters.description: Use of the 24 h window of the conversation. global counts every sent turn; sale, recovery and free their own; retentionSent the sent retention turns (drafts never count).

Escalation.description: The open continue-kind escalation: the assistant still answers, without sale links (AGENT_OPEN_PROBLEM).

VoiceNote.description: A voice note the saas already synthesized (the seller's ElevenLabs key) and hosts at url. The core delivers it as a WhatsApp voice message BEFORE the bubbles. A failed synthesis never reaches the core: the saas sends only the bubbles.

AudioMessage.description: The stored voice note of a turn: its own message and delivery, sent first.

AgentEscalateResponse.description: kind continue: the escalation is open and the assistant keeps the conversation (held false). kind silence: an explicit hold (reason agent, the summary as note). created is true only when THIS call opened it; the saas pushes once per creation.

AgentMarkBody.description: purchase_lookup_empty: the search by the conversation phone found nothing. email_lookup: a search by a typed e-mail ran. Both feed AGENT_ASK_EMAIL_FIRST.

AgentSettings.description: The seller's assistant settings. A seller who never saved reads the GG defaults with updatedAt null. voice is the panel view (never the key); the key has its own routes (agent-voice).

limits.description: The seller's caps inside the GG ceilings (x-limits). retentionAttempts may only go down from 2.

AgentSettingsPutBody.description: Replaces the whole settings. expectedUpdatedAt is the updatedAt the screen read (null when it read the defaults): a different stored one is refused with 409 AGENT_SETTINGS_CHANGED, so a screen opened earlier never undoes an edit made elsewhere.

limits.description: The seller's caps inside the GG ceilings (x-limits). retentionAttempts may only go down from 2.

AgentTask.description: A message the assistant starts for the journey block 'Assistente escreve'. The journey creates the task when a buyer reaches the block; it is listed in PendingPage.tasks from dueAt until deadlineAt (dueAt moves to the next BRT day when the contact's daily cap is full, and the task expires with daily_cap if that day is past the deadline). A task resolves ONCE (AgentTaskResult) and the journey follows 'Mandou' on sent and 'Nao mandou ate o prazo' on expired or refused. A contact with a live task reads as a conversation even before it ever wrote (GET state answers a free state with counters at zero; offer and marks accept it). Voice notes are never part of a task.

AgentTaskReplyBody.description: The task's message. Always sent (a started message is never a draft, never a voice note); the category follows the objective: pix_reminder recovery, offer sale, welcome and free free. contactKey is the contact the saas reviewed the links against: a task of another contact (or of another seller) answers 404 AGENT_TASK_NOT_FOUND, never revealing that it exists. The accepted turn resolves the task as sent.

turnClientMessageId.description: The clientMessageId of a turn: at most 56, because bubble i (i >= 1) is stored under <id>-b<i> and the voice note under <id>-audio, and every derived id stays inside the 64 of the delivery idempotency.

agentObjective.description: What the journey block asks the assistant to write. pix_reminder: the unpaid PIX (category recovery). welcome: after the purchase, no link, no question, no offer (category free). offer: the next upsell or a catalog item with its link (category sale). free: the seller's instruction (category free).

taskInstruction.description: The seller's own instruction configured on a free block: STORE text, handed to the model inside the store block, never inside the untrusted buyer block. Up to 500 code points.

taskResultCode.description: Why a task did not resolve as sent. expired: deadline (nothing sent in time), daily_cap (the contact's daily cap never opened before the deadline). refused at creation or send: agent_disabled (no live agent key), opted_out, contact_exited (SAIR), held, no_phone. refused by the saas (POST .../skip): open_escalation, retention_or_refund, already_bought, nothing_to_say.

AgentTaskResult.description: The final result of a task, decided once under the task's row lock: a send that loses the race to the deadline answers 409 AGENT_TASK_EXPIRED, and an expiry that loses to the send reads sent. The journey run event shows it.

AgentTaskSkipBody.description: The saas decided the task should not be written (the offer conditions of the spec, or the model had nothing to say): the task resolves refused at once and the journey takes 'Nao mandou' without waiting for the deadline.

voiceCiphertext.description: The seller's ElevenLabs key, AES-256-GCM by the saas with the sellerId in the AAD. Opaque to the core: stored and returned as is, never decrypted, never logged.

AgentVoice.description: The panel view of the voice key: whether one is stored, its last 4 characters and the voice. Never the key.

AgentVoiceSecret.description: The voice key as the assistant reads it (GET agent/settings, agent key only).

AgentSettingsForAgent.description: GET agent/settings: the settings with the voice key the assistant needs to synthesize and transcribe.

limits.description: The seller's caps inside the GG ceilings (x-limits). retentionAttempts may only go down from 2.

AgentVoicePutBody.description: Saves the voice key and voice (panel session only, never the agent key). elevenlabsKeyCiphertext and last4 null keep the stored key and change only the voice (409 AGENT_VOICE_KEY_MISSING when none is stored).

AgentVoiceLookupBody.description: The webhook of a received voice note: the chip it arrived on, as the ingest identifies it.

AgentVoiceLookup.description: Only when the chip's seller has the assistant on AND a stored key; any other case (unknown chip, assistant off, no key) is the same 404 AGENT_VOICE_NOT_FOUND.
